description: Capability for the first-run wizard window (M3/S6, `.copilot/wp/15.md`; get_wizard_product_catalog added S8). Same least-privilege discipline as capabilities/settings.json, scoped to the DIFFERENT, disjoint IPC surface this window actually calls: get_wizard_state()/get_wizard_product_catalog()/wizard_choose_products()/wizard_set_layers()/wizard_begin_signin()/wizard_poll_signin()/wizard_advance()/is_first_run() — never get_state/refresh_now/hide_popover/get_settings/save_settings (this window has no doctor-popover or settings-form concerns) and never open_settings_window. allow-open-wizard-window is granted HERE (not broadened onto capabilities/default.json's popover grants) so a future in-wizard 'reopen' affordance has a home without widening any existing window's capability; the popover's own first-run auto-open path (lib.rs's .setup()) shows/focuses the window directly in Rust and needs no IPC grant at all. No core:event:allow-listen — like the Settings window, this is a get-on-open, drive-one-step-at-a-time surface with no live push event to subscribe to. No fs/shell/http/dialog plugin is linked at all — every profile read/manifest write/sign-in spawn/doctor re-poll step happens Rust-side, behind these typed commands, never as a filesystem or process capability granted to the webview itself.
